### Meaning
| infl.     | class  | meaning                                            |
| --------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| ~         | *n.*   | desire, will, want, longing, yearning / permission |
| ~en       | *v.*   | to long for, want                                  |
| ~a        | *psv.* | wanted, desired                                    |
| ~an       | *adj.* | yearnful, driven, ambitious                        |
### Implied meaning
- request
- begging
- expectation
### Antonym
- [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Feelings/kse\|kse]]
### Etymology
#### Glyph
similar to 欠; a depiction of a kneeling person with their arms out to request receiving something (instead of an open mouth in the oracle bone script character) - imagine a beggar or a child wanting something
#### Sound
- *a priori:* h=emptiness/hunger, y=aspiration, a=energy
- Related to [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Body parts/han\|han]] (hungry mouth)
